color.note: Dark only. Ember Gallery (refined 2026-10-13): deep midnight ground, warm bone whites, steel greys. Ember orange appears on the logo mark and on the one main action of a screen, nowhere else. drakon-*, midnight-*, bone-*, steel-* are the raw palette; use the role tokens in UI.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background, and the colour every photo fades into. Lay the grain texture over it on full pages.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels that hold a task: order summary, checkout steps, dialogs, admin tables. Not for product cards: products sit straight on surface.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: The header over the hero photo, gallery labels and round buttons that sit on photos, always with a 20px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Input fill, hover fill for ghost buttons and nav links, and image wells before a photo loads.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, table rows, panel edges. Decoration only (1.3:1 on surface), never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: inputs, secondary buttons, unselected size buttons. 3.8:1 on surface, 3.6:1 on surface-raised, 3.4:1 on field.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Headlines, product names, prices, the wordmark, the current nav underline and the cart count bubble (with on-accent text). 17.3:1 on surface, 16.1:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and input values. 15.0:1 on surface, 13.1:1 on field.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: intros, labels, nav links, meta lines. 9.6:1 on surface, 8.5:1 on field.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Hints, captions, struck-out sold-out prices and placeholders. 6.1:1 on surface, 5.7:1 on surface-raised, 5.4:1 on field.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: the logo mark and the one main button of a screen (Add to cart, Place order, Shop the drop), plus the current step dot in order tracking. Never prices, nav lines, counts, badges or every link. 6.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for anything filled with accent.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange text, rarely: inline text links inside sentences and the required-field mark. Not nav links. 8.2:1 on surface, 7.6:1 on surface-raised, 7.2:1 on field.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (6.5:1), accent-hover (8.2:1) and on ink-strong fills such as the cart count. Never white on orange.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring with a 2px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Form errors only, always with a word or icon. 10.1:1 on surface, 9.4:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay on a photo behind controls.

tokens.name: midnight-975
tokens.usage: The deepest midnight. Behind surface and on-accent, and the black point of every product photo.

tokens.name: midnight-925
tokens.usage: Behind field: inputs and empty image wells.

tokens.name: midnight-850
tokens.usage: Behind line: hairlines and dividers.

tokens.name: midnight-450
tokens.usage: Behind line-strong: the edge of anything you click or type in.

tokens.name: bone-50
tokens.usage: Warm white, as if lit by the ember key light. Behind ink-strong.

tokens.name: bone-100
tokens.usage: Behind ink.

tokens.name: steel-300
tokens.usage: Cool grey. Behind ink-muted.

tokens.name: steel-400
tokens.usage: Behind ink-subtle.

tokens.name: drakon-50
tokens.usage: Reserved. Light-theme tint; unused while the MVP is dark only.

tokens.name: drakon-100
tokens.usage: Reserved. Light-theme tint; unused while the MVP is dark only.

tokens.name: drakon-200
tokens.usage: Reserved. Light-theme tint; unused while the MVP is dark only.

tokens.name: drakon-300
tokens.usage: Reserved. Light-theme tint; unused while the MVP is dark only.

tokens.name: drakon-400
tokens.usage: Behind accent-hover, accent-text and focus.

tokens.name: drakon-500
tokens.usage: The brand orange, behind accent.

tokens.name: drakon-600
tokens.usage: The old button colour. Do not fill buttons with it under white text (3.8:1).

tokens.name: drakon-700
tokens.usage: Deep ember for large decorative shapes only, such as the cover.

tokens.name: drakon-800
tokens.usage: Reserved.

tokens.name: drakon-900
tokens.usage: Reserved.

tokens.name: drakon-950
tokens.usage: Reserved.

tokens.name: midnight-50
tokens.usage: Reserved. Light-theme tint; unused while the MVP is dark only.

tokens.name: midnight-100
tokens.usage: Reserved. Light-theme tint; unused while the MVP is dark only.

tokens.name: midnight-200
tokens.usage: Reserved. Light-theme tint; unused while the MVP is dark only.

tokens.name: midnight-300
tokens.usage: Reserved.

tokens.name: midnight-400
tokens.usage: Reserved. Was line-strong; replaced by the quieter midnight-450.

tokens.name: midnight-500
tokens.usage: Reserved.

tokens.name: midnight-600
tokens.usage: The old input border. Below 3:1 on surface-raised, so never the edge of a control.

tokens.name: midnight-700
tokens.usage: Decorative shapes on the cover. Was line before the refresh.

tokens.name: midnight-800
tokens.usage: Reserved. Was field before the Ember Gallery refresh.

tokens.name: midnight-900
tokens.usage: Reserved. Was surface-raised before the Ember Gallery refresh; too light and blue for panels.

tokens.name: midnight-950
tokens.usage: Behind surface-raised: panels, the order summary, dialogs.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Outfit from Google Fonts, 400–700, with Noto Sans Bengali second in the stack so the Taka sign (৳) always comes from one face that matches Outfit digits. One scale for everything: 12 · 13 · 14 · 16 · 18 · 20 · 24 · 28 · 36 · 48 · 52 · 64 · 88.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The home hero headline from 1024px wide. One per site, in ink-strong.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: The hero headline from 640px to 1023px wide.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page titles and the product name on its page, from 640px wide. Below 640px use heading-2.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section titles; page titles below 640px. Never a third size in between.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Panel titles: summary, checkout steps, admin cards.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Product names in grids and lists, one line.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Each drop is one numbered run.
styles.usage: Hero and section intros, at most 560px wide, in ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We call you to confirm before we ship.
styles.usage: All running text, table cells, summary rows and input values. There is no 15px or 17px step.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links and form labels. Sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, stock notes, meta lines, table secondary lines and the gallery label meta line.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Badges and the cart count. Sentence case, never tracked caps.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices in grids, lists and gallery labels, in ink-strong (not orange), with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) so columns line up; struck through in ink-subtle when sold out.

styles.name: price-lg
styles.usage: The price on the product page, the order total and the order number; tabular figures.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Counts and stock figures inside labels and tables ("12 left", "3 items"), tabular figures.

groups.name: Bangla
groups.note: Bangla UI is planned for Phase 2.

styles.name: bangla-body
styles.usage: Any Bangla text; same size steps as the English it replaces, 2px more leading.

spacing.note: 4px base, everything on an 8px grid except the 4px and 12px steps inside small parts. No 2, 6, 10, 14, 18 or 22px gaps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Name to meta line in cards and labels; icon to badge text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to input; icon to text in buttons; mark to wordmark.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; gaps inside a product card's text; gallery label inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter; image to text in a product card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gap on phones; panel padding on phones; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Product grid column gap from 1024px.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title block and short content; hero copy blocks.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Section header to its grid on full pages.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Product grid row gap; between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablets.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section padding from 1024px. Roomy is the brand.

radius.note: Radius grows with the size of the thing. Never one radius for everything.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Thumbnails under 64px, nav link hover fills, chips.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, size buttons, the logo mark.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Product photos, menus, the mobile nav sheet.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Panels: order summary, checkout steps, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, the cart count, round icon buttons.

shadow.note: Neutral black only; no coloured glows. Depth mostly comes from the photos.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Panels on surface: a faint top edge and a long soft fall-off, like the photos.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, the mobile nav sheet and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-label
tokens.usage: Gallery labels that sit over a photo: a faint top edge and a soft fall-off, so the label reads as a card resting on the slate.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content, with space-4, space-6 and space-8 gutters on phone, tablet and desktop.

tokens.name: form-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of single-column flows: order placed, order tracking, Create With Drakon.

tokens.name: text-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of intro paragraphs (about 70 characters).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: The site header bar.

tokens.name: hero-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the home hero photo from 1024px wide.

tokens.name: logo-mark
tokens.usage: Width and height of the D mark in the header (32px in admin).

tokens.name: label-width
tokens.usage: Width of a gallery label placed over a photo on desktop; on phones it sits full width under the photo.
